title: Add QEMU TUI console smoke
purpose: Extend QEMU smoke so it proves the AgentOS boot path exposes a TUI-ready console, not only agentd handoff.
scope: Update boot-smoke-test.ps1 or add a TUI-specific smoke mode.
Use QEMU path E:\qemu\qemu-system-x86_64.exe when provided.
Assert AGENTD_HANDOFF_OK, runtime marker and TUI-ready marker.
Capture console output evidence under workflow artifacts.
Keep timeout and headless execution suitable for CI.
acceptance_criteria: QEMU smoke can prove TUI-ready boot marker.
Smoke fails if TUI marker is missing while handoff still succeeds.
Smoke evidence records QEMU path, timeout, observed markers and result.
No network or external LLM dependency is introduced.
failure_modes: TUI smoke requires manual interactive input.
Smoke output is not persisted as evidence.
